name: Our Lady of the Valley, Clitheroe

boundary.description: NE from Apronfull Hill OS778394 by the civil parish boundary to Ogden Clough, and along it to and along the Ribble Valley and Pendle District Boundary over Pendle Hill to the diocesan boundary at Helliwell Wood OS833428. NW by the diocesan boundary across Twiston Moor to the start of Ings Brook W by this brook via Clough Head, Ings End OS815447 to its confluence with Swanside Beck OS785454 and by Smithies Brook to Smithies Bridge on the A59. N by the River Ribble N to Skirden Beck to Grunsagill OS782543. N by Tosside Beck to the point where it crosses B6478. Then N by a bee-line to the junction of A65 and B6480 at Clapham. Then W along B6480 to boundary between Lancaster and Craven Districts. S along that boundary and then the Ribble Valley – Lancaster Civil boundary over Hawthorntwaite Fell to the Ribble Valley – Wyre Civil boundary OS575505 SE to the cairn on Fair Snape Fell W by the Civil boundary with Bowland-with-Leagram to Burholme Bridge OS657479 S by the River Hodder to River Ribble SE by the Ribble to a point opposite the confluence of Pig Hill Brook OS723394 SE by a straight line to the junction of the A671 and the A59T and by a second straight line to the 315 trig point near Jeppe Knave Grave OS762380, then SE by the edge of the wood to and along the track and road past Wiswell Moor Houses to the track at Lower Clerk Farm OS751364, then by the stream to its confluence with Sabden Brook and by Sabden Brook to Old Read Bridge OS752354, then E along Old Roman Road, Back Lane and Stump Hall Road and Haddings Lane past Haddings Head, and right along the unnamed road and track to Spenbrook Road OS822383 and NW by tracks via Bull Hole to Well Head OS816393 on Well Head Road, then by straight lines to Driver Height, Spence Moor and Apronfull Hill.
